exercises: three references that resolve to nothing: a parameter, a response body schema and a whole response
note: Deliberately invalid. openapi-spec-validator rejects it, because an unresolvable reference is a document defect. The browser must still render it: a specification that fails validation is exactly when a reader most needs to see what is wrong, and a browser that renders a blank row is indistinguishable from one that is broken itself.

expected.assert: The operation renders. One bad reference does not cost the reader the whole page.
The unresolved parameter still produces a row, naming the pointer that failed, rather than vanishing.
The unresolved response body says the pointer could not be resolved, rather than showing an empty schema.
The 404 still appears as a status, with text saying the document does not define what it references.
The failure is attributed to the document, not presented as if the API documents nothing.
The intact parts, the bookId parameter and the 200 status, render normally.
